dialogues.en:
I calculated the right time and left home just so that I
could bump into Moe-sempai, but I didn't see her this
morning.
dialogues.text:
I calculated the right time and left home just so that I
could bump into Moe-sempai, but I didn't see her this
morning.

dialogues.jp: 鞄を机の横に引っ掛け、席に座る。
dialogues.en:
It's not that we were trying to meet each other, so I guess
some days are like this.
dialogues.text:
It's not that we were trying to meet each other, so I guess
some days are like this.

dialogues.jp: （今日は萌先輩に会わなかったな……）
dialogues.en:
I get to see her at lunch, and she doesn't have a club
meeting today. That means she'll come to my house and......
dialogues.text:
I get to see her at lunch, and she doesn't have a club
meeting today. That means she'll come to my house and......

dialogues.jp:
登校時、先輩に会える時間帯を見計らって家を
出たはずだけど、珍しく会えなかった。

まあ、待ち合わせしているわけじゃないから、
たまにはこういう事もあるか。

登校時、先輩に合わせた時間に家を出たんだが、
結局先輩に会えずじまいで、学園に着いてしまっ
た。
dialogues.en:
I sat on my seat after hanging my bag on the side of the
desk.
dialogues.text:
I sat on my seat after hanging my bag on the side of the
desk.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、別に待ち合わせているわけじゃないし、
こういう事もあるよな。
